fat_pct.quote: * fat for 9 cheeses including Sardo: **27.5 to 29.7% (wt/wt)**, protein **26.4 to 27.7% (wt/wt)**

salt_pct.quote: * NaCl content rather uniform in all cheeses and ranged from **1.5 to 2.3% (wt/wt)**.

ammonia.reason: Low protein deamination in 45-day thermized curd; starter deaminases produce little NH3.

animal_barnyard.reason: Sheep pasture-derived p-cresol and indole plus stable phenols give mild barnyard.

bitter.reason: Calf rennet hydrophobic peptides partly hydrolyzed by Lactococcus lactis peptidases.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti; only trace 2-heptanone/2-nonanone from milk lipase.

browning.reason: Residual lactose/galactose plus lysine drive Maillard on heating.

buttery.reason: Starter citrate metabolism to diacetyl/acetoin plus milkfat C4 short-chain acids.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Sheep-milk lipolysis releases butanoic/hexanoic/octanoic acids causing sweaty-cheesy note.

creaminess.reason: ~44% fat-in-dry-matter and 38.5% moisture give smooth creamy mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Young cooked-pressed matrix at pH 5.3 is elastic-sliceable, not fractured-crumbly.

firmness.reason: Cooked 43-45C pressed curd at 38.5% moisture forms firm semi-hard body.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylalanine catabolism to phenylacetaldehyde and 2-phenylethanol gives light floral.

fruity.reason: Lactic cocci esterases esterify fatty acids to ethyl butanoate/hexanoate.

goaty.reason: Ewe branched-chain 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic acids give characteristic sheep-goaty note.

melt.reason: pH 5.3 rennet casein with intact network flows moderately without pasta-filata alignment.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Trace 1-octen-3-ol from linoleate oxidation; no bloomy mold contributes earthiness.

oil_off.reason: Moderate free fat from 27.5% fat pools as oil when heated.

smoky.reason: No smoking step and no guaiacol/phenol formation in typical dolce make.

sour_vinegar.reason: Streptococcus thermophilus/Lactococcus lactic and acetic acids at pH 5.3-4.8.

stretch.reason: No hot-water stretching; rennet-cooked casein has no aligned filata fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Mild 43-45C cook and low Lactococcus methionine-lyase limit H2S/methanethiol.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose/lactate plus sweet amino acids proline/alanine in ewe milk.

umami.reason: Rennet/plasmin proteolysis releases glutamate/aspartate in 45-day ripening.
